hibs.label: the kings of Media and Persia
the people who are the saints
Daniel
hibs.reconciliation_note: Dropping this HIB's Dan 1 verse coverage (Dan.1.6-21) only -- Dan 1's lexical was judged not at the right standard (researcher, 2026-08-07) and is being cleared/regenerated from scratch. Daniel's Dan 8 verse coverage is untouched -- Dan 8 is separately completed, validated work (debate_status=complete) and is not part of this clear. The Daniel HIB entity itself stays live (it still holds real, correct Dan 8 content) -- only its Dan 1 half is being removed here, to be re-derived fresh once the new Dan 1 lexical exists.

quality_checks.is-genuinely-human: Unaffected by this edit -- Daniel's status as a genuinely human referent was already established for the Dan 8 content this HIB keeps; nothing new is being asserted.
quality_checks.not-already-excluded: Not applicable -- this is a narrowing of an existing HIB's verse coverage, not a new referent being introduced.
quality_checks.verse-actually-supports-it: The retained verse set (Dan 8 only) is exactly what was already verified against the lexical during the Dan 8 debate build; no new verse claim is being made here.
